{{Quote|Mon Calamari, Agamar and Bakura have all reported similar attacks.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Game" />}}
During the [[Dark Reaper crisis]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched an '''attack''' on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].

==The attack==
After the [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|recovery]] of the [[Force Harvester]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and a first [[Battle on Alaris|test]] on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] unleashed the device on other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as Mon Calamari, [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] and [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="Game" />

==Aftermath==
The devastation caused by the Force Harvester frightened many [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] into cooperating with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], despite the [[Mon Calamari Council|Calamarian Council's]] initial rejection of Dooku's offer to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="GatORW" />

However, some viewed this event as an opportunity to win glory away from [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]]. Among those were [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Merai]], a decorated hero of the [[Quarren War]], who willingly joined the Separatist cause. Later, Commander Merai received the honor of leading Separatist troops against [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces in the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]].<ref name="GatORW" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' mistakenly states that Mon Calamari was attacked by the [[Dark Reaper]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="GatORW" /> The planet was actually attacked by its power source, the Force Harvester.<ref name="TNEC" />
